target.title: fix(cli): use startsWith for loopback IPv4 check in container proxy
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`isLoopbackProxyHostname` used `split(".", 1)[0] === "127"` to detect 127.0.0.0/8 loopback addresses. While `isIP()` already rejects invalid octets (leading zeros, out-of-range) before this branch, `split(".", 1)[0]` is unnecessarily indirect and obscures the intent of matching the full 127.0.0.0/8 range.

## Why This Change Was Made

`startsWith("127.")` directly expresses the intent of matching any valid IPv4 address in the 127.0.0.0/8 loopback block. It is equivalent in behavior (since `isIP() === 4` already validated the format) but clearer and less fragile.

## User Impact

No behavior change — same loopback detection logic, just more readable and maintainable.

## Evidence

```text
$ npx vitest run src/cli/container-target.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  32 passed (32)
```

All existing test cases including `127.0.0.01` (rejected by `isIP()`) and `127.0.0.1` (detected as loopback) continue to pass.

## AI-assisted

No.
